text:
Ari (Product): Pushed an updated Figma link for the model catalog -> compare + filters flow. Main goals: make compare table scannable, clarify performance badges, and make version pin/unpin obvious. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (comments enabled)
Sam (Design): Nice iteration. A few immediate things: filters should show active count (e.g., "Filters (3)") and be collapsible on small screens. Also consider a "density" toggle for the compare table.
Riley (Frontend): Agree on collapsible filters. Implementation note: if we keep the filters sticky we need to virtualize rows to avoid jank when comparing 50+ models.
Jordan (Engineering): Perf badges are calculated at ingest time so we can expose p50/p95 + cost-estimate per 1k tokens. Suggest badge text like: "p50 42ms · p95 120ms · $0.12/1k" so product can scan both latency and cost.
Taylor (PM): Copy nit: "Pin version" feels ambiguous. Users sometimes think it pins the model globally. Proposal: change to "Pin to route" or "Pin to deployment" depending on context.
Sam (Design): +1 to more explicit copy. Also badges need clear color semantics — green=fast, amber=ok, red=slow — but also a shape/label for colorblind users. Add small icon (⚡️, ~, ⏱) or text abbreviation.
Lana (QA): Accessibility checklist: keyboard focus order through the compare table, ARIA for the pin button, and ensure badges have accessible names. Example: aria-labels for pin buttons should include model name and version.
Lana (QA): small example snippet for pin button aria: 
```
<button aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Pin version 2.1.0 of model 'redwood/gpt-lite'">Pin</button>
```
Riley (Frontend): For keyboard nav, propose: `f` focuses filters, `space` toggles selection, `p` pins selected model. Also quick action menu (three dots) should be reachable via `Enter` when focused.
Jordan (Engineering): Backend will expose extra metrics in the model metadata API under `serving_metrics` { p50, p95, cost_per_k }. We should agree on field names before front-end work.
Sam (Design): Table layout thought: freeze the first two columns (model name + pinned indicator) and let the metric columns scroll horizontally. On mobile collapse to stacked cards that show the three most important metrics.
Taylor (PM): UX question: how does pin/unpin affect rollouts? Should pinning create an implicit route or just mark preferred version for quick selection? We should define behavior.
Ari (Product): I want pin to be quick-action (local preference) and also have an explicit "Make default" flow that opens modal with confirmation. So two actions: "Pin for me" and "Set as default for route".
Sam (Design): UI affordance: use a small pin icon + label that changes to "Pinned (you)" vs "Pinned (global)". Tooltip explains difference.
Riley (Frontend): Technical impl note: add `data-qa` attributes for pin/unpin for e2e tests and a11y hooks.
Lana (QA): Test cases to add: screen reader reads badge as "Latency p50 42 milliseconds, p95 120 milliseconds"; keyboard users can pin/unpin and open compare with purely keyboard.
Jordan (Engineering): One more: metrics freshness badge (e.g., small clock icon) — we should show when perf snapshot was taken. If older than 7 days show a warning.
Sam (Design): Visual tweak: performance badges should include microcopy under the table header: "p50 / p95 · est cost" so users know what the columns mean. Also increase contrast on amber text to meet AA.
Ari (Product): OK sounds like we have alignment. Quick poll: thumbs for go-ahead on proposed copy + sticky filters + p50/p95 + two-level pin action?
Sam (Design): :thumbsup:
Riley (Frontend): :thumbsup:
Jordan (Engineering): :thumbsup:
Taylor (PM): :thumbsup:
Lana (QA): :thumbsup:
Ari (Product): Great — I'll file a short PRD with the copy/table behavior and tag front-end and eng. Scheduling a 20m sync tomorrow to walk the Figma and agree on API fields. Thanks all!
